messages:
lina-partnerships: Heads up: NovaAppliance wants to switch from hourly batched usage exports to per-minute events next month. They want a short migration window and a reconciliation playbook.

omar-eng: Do we have to change canonical units? We currently store usage as minutes in billing.

lina-partnerships: They
re proposing `usage_seconds` in the payload. Sample they shared: `\{"device\":\"nova-42\",\"ts\":\"2026-03-21T11:22:00Z\",\"usage_seconds\":60,\"sku\":\"redwood.edge.xsmall\"}`

tia-devex: We'll need a partner sandbox + replay tool and golden files. Also document how we aggregate or map seconds->minutes for billing.

omar-eng: Ingest approach: accept both schemas for a coexistence period, add a parser option to aggregate seconds into minute buckets by rounding up, and feature flag the new path. Estimate 2 dev days + 1 infra day.

ev an-sre: small ops asks: require `idempotency_key` on events, add per-partner rate limits, and dashboarding for ingestion latency and duplicate rates. Backfill jobs must be rate-limited.

nina-legal: Legal note: changing billing granularity can affect contracts and proration. We need amendment language and a 30-day customer notice in most agreements. Keep audit trail for invoice adjustments.

partner-ingest-bot: ACTION: created ticket #PRT-2901 assigned to omar-eng. Tasks: schema-support, sandbox, backfill-plan, legal signoff, billing validation.

lina-partnerships: Nova asked to start cutover 2026-04-08 and stop hourly exports 2026-04-15. Two-week window. Is that doable?

omar-eng: Tight but doable with canary (limit to 5 devices) + parallel dev. We'll post a deploy plan today.

tia-devex: I'll produce sandbox + replay instructions and mapping CSV by EOD tomorrow. Example mapping row we'll include: `nova_small,redwood.edge.xsmall,seconds -> minutes,round_up`.

ev an-sre: Ops will add alert if synthetic idempotency rate > 5% and a throttling policy for backfills.

nina-legal: I'll draft amendment referencing 2026-04-08 effective date once you lock it.

lina-partnerships: Action items recap: (1) omar scope + estimate + deploy plan, (2) tia sandbox + docs, (3) nina amendment draft, (4) evan monitoring + rate-limits. I'll request last-30-days sample payloads from Nova. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
